Powerful Capabilities

Built for Modern Kubernetes Engineers

Experience seamless local microservices development with enterprise features out of the box.

🌐

Cluster Connection Manager →

Automatically discover kubeconfig contexts and namespaces. Configure mapped namespaces, proxy subnets, and auto-save profiles for 1-click reconnections.

--also-proxy --vnat Auto-Save
🎯

Visual Workload Intercepts →

Route traffic from any cluster pod to your local debugger (localhost:8080) or local Docker container. Test your code live against real upstream cluster services.

Local Port Docker Run 1-Click Detach
🔀

Multi-Developer Header Routing →

Share the same staging cluster safely without collisions! Route only requests matching custom HTTP headers (e.g. x-dev-user=alice) to your machine.

HTTP Headers Envoy Matching Team Sharing
🖥️

Native System Tray & Background Poller →

Runs quietly in your system tray on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Receive instant desktop notifications on connection events and manage daemon state.

Systray Single Instance Real-time Polling
🔄

In-App Auto Updates →

Built-in release detection powered by GitHub Releases. Downloads matching OS and WebKit ABI binaries, applies in-place patches, and restarts in seconds.

Self-Update ABI Detection 1-Click Patch
🛡️

Enterprise RBAC & Impersonation →

Support for bearer tokens, client TLS certificates/keys, user/group/UID impersonation (--as, --as-group), and custom CA certificate configurations.

--as Client mTLS Tokens
⚙️

Application Settings & Themes →

Granular preferences for dark/light themes, aurora glows, splash screen, notification triggers, tray minimize rules, and streaming log buffer limits.

Themes Glow Effects Custom Titlebar
🛠️

Automated Dependency Checks →

Pre-flight verification for Telepresence CLI and Kubectl on startup with live path/version reporting and 1-click guided installation instructions.

Pre-Flight Self-Healing Auto-Check
Workflow Evolution

CLI Complexity vs. Visual Speed

❌ Official Terminal CLI
Must memorize 15+ complex CLI flags and CIDR ranges
Manual typing of contexts and namespaces on every restart
Plain text terminal output with no live filtering or sorting
Must keep terminal sessions open; no tray integration
✨ Telepresence GUI
Multi-tab visual form with auto-completion and validation
Auto-discovered kubeconfig contexts and 1-click profiles
High-speed TanStack table with live search, sorting, and pagination
Native system tray, background polling, and desktop alerts
Cross-Platform Support
